name: Solar inverter–battery compatibility
description: Which lithium batteries have been tested with which solar inverter brands for closed-loop BMS communication, from the inverter and battery manufacturers' own published compatibility lists. Each record names the inverter brand, the battery brand and model, the communication protocol (CAN, RS485, etc.), minimum firmware versions required, system types supported (off-grid, backup, ESS), and any noted restrictions. Answers 'will battery X talk to inverter Y' — the question the scenario research found assistants hedge on with 'check the manufacturer's compatibility PDF' rather than stating the pairing.
licence: factual compilation from manufacturer published compatibility documents; facts cited with attributed quotes, no document reproduced

1.4 Solar Charger compatibility All 48V BlueSolar and SmartSolar VE.Direct MPPT Chargers are compatible (*). Some of our Solar Chargers feature a VE.Direct communication port, some feature a VE.Can communication port, and some feature both. Both of these types of communication ports can be used to connect the Solar charger to the GX Device. Such connection is mandatory, because it is used to regulate charge currents and voltages. When planning to use the VE.Can communications port to connect the Solar Charger(s), make sure to select a GX Device that has sufficient CAN-Bus ports. The Color Control GX has only one such port, its VE.Can port, and is therefor not suitable. All other GX Devices can be used, since they have two ports. One can then be used to connect the BYD battery, and the other to connect the Solar Charger.
